results.message: Compare the tallest building in Birmingham with the tallest in Manchester: give both names, both heights in metres, and by how many metres one is taller.
results.answer:
As of the latest results, Birmingham’s tallest is ONE Eastside Tower 1 at 155.2 metres. Manchester’s tallest is Deansgate Square South Tower at 200.5 metres. ([skyscrapercenter.com](https://www.skyscrapercenter.com/city/birmingham))

Birmingham’s tallest building in 2025 was The Octagon, at 155 m (509 ft). In Manchester, the tallest completed building is Deansgate Square South Tower, at 201 m (about 659 ft)—not Three60, which is 154 m. Sources accessed October 26, 2026; the Skyscraper Center’s 2026 ranking lists Three60, but its Manchester building page identifies it as not the city’s tallest. results.message: Who won the Booker Prize in each of the last three years, and which of those three books is the shortest?
results.answer:
The 2025 Booker Prize winner was David Szalay for *Flesh*; the 2024 winner was Samantha Harvey for *Orbital*; and the 2023 winner was Paul Lynch for *Prophet Song*. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/the-booker-library/prize-years/2025))

Of those three, *Orbital* is shortest at 136 pages, compared with *Prophet Song* at 320 pages. Page counts vary by edition; the sources list different counts for *Orbital*. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Booker_Prize))

2025: David Szalay, *Flesh*. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/media-centre/press-releases/flesh-by-david-szalay-wins-the-booker-prize-2025))  
2024: Samantha Harvey, *Orbital*. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/the-booker-library/prize-years/2024))  
2023: Paul Lynch, *Prophet Song*. ([thebookerprizes.com](https://thebookerprizes.com/the-booker-library/prize-years/2023))
